original_test_intent: Verify all expected TEMP1 sensors for HIB VR1 through VRN are correctly mapped to their VR components and physical locations and report human-readable temperature, status and thresholds matching the approved VR thermal specification.
original_method: Define TEMP1 sensing placement, enumerate every expected HIB VR channel and immutable raw/UI identity, collect complete temperature/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized nearby temperatures, fan/PWM and VR power context, and compare each raw and WebUI result to the owner specification.
manual_activity: The owner defines TEMP1 placement, HIB VR topology and limits; an operator verifies raw/UI readability and passive context, and the owner adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and HIB VR1..N hardware inventory
TEMP1 physical sensing location and HIB VR-to-SDR/Redfish/UI mapping
Read-only nearby temperature, fan/PWM and VR input/output power context
UI refresh/rounding/sensor-lag tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep the check read-only and passive; never change VR voltage/load, fan, threshold or thermal policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each TEMP1 reading to its physical HIB VR and synchronized context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on overtemperature, VR fault, alarm, impossible/stale value or mapping/cooling issue
Do not create VR thermal stress or retry after changing load/airflow
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate and verify the complete TEMP1 HIB VR population and physical mappings
Collect complete raw values, units, status, thresholds, identities and timestamps with passive context
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/rounding normalization
Report missing, extra, stale, alarm, placement or raw/UI/context/spec mismatches for owner verdict
Perform no VR/thermal stimulus or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply authoritative TEMP1 placement, HIB VR mapping and thermal limits
Review VR power/thermal, raw/UI and context discrepancies or alarms

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate the complete SDR/Redfish inventory, select all owner-mapped TEMP1 HIB VR records, capture full metadata and synchronized passive thermal/fan/VR-power context, then correlate WebUI rows to the specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP1_HIB_VR1~N scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED HIB VR TEMP1 POPULATION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-VR matrix containing HIB/VR and TEMP1 physical location, raw temperature/unit/status/threshold, nearby thermal/fan/power context and UI display, with population and specification results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact TEMP1 placement and VR context while replacing insecure/truncated reads, log clearing and active stimulation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One temperature or screenshot cannot cover VR1..N or establish TEMP1 placement. Every expected VR TEMP1 channel and threshold must be reconciled independently of TEMP2.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: TEMP1 may identify a controller, power-stage or board-site sensor; expected value and lag depend on that placement and VR load, so a generic range is unsafe.

project_override_considerations: If a VR lacks TEMP1 or exposes multiple first-channel sensors, the owner must define expected population and naming; the adjacent TEMP2 case remains separate even if the values track closely.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/HIB VR topology/thermal spec revision
TEMP1 physical location and per-VR raw/UI identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved scaling/rounding/lag comparison
Per-VR discrepancies, no-stimulus/no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target TEMP1 HIB VR temperatures and thresholds. Physical placement and exact mapping are required project inputs rather than contradictory source instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: TEMP1 placement, VR mapping, thermal specification and complete raw/UI/context evidence gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Makes TEMP1 physical meaning and per-VR coverage explicit and prevents the adjacent TEMP2 channel from being used as substitute evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: VR thermal interpretation changes substantially depending on whether TEMP1 is near the controller, inductor, power stage or board. A reasonable Celsius value cannot prove correct mapping, and matching TEMP2 may merely reflect nearby placement rather than duplicate identity. The check therefore needs an owner physical map plus per-channel identifiers and synchronized VR power/fan context. It remains passive because deliberately loading or changing VR policy would expand the source scope and thermal risk.
